tool.name: HmtG-PacBio Pipeline
tool.description: Comprehensive pipeline for processing Haemosporidian mitochondrial genome data from PacBio sequencing.
tool.command: python '$__tool_directory__/HmtG-PacBio-Pipeline.py' -rR '$rawReads' -pF '$primerF' -pR '$primerR' -eps $epsDBScan #if str($remove_files) == "yes": -rF 'yes' #else -rF 'no' #end if #if str($run_blast) == "yes": -rB 'yes' #else -rB 'no' #end if && mkdir -p '$summary.extra_files_path' && cp summary_distances.tsv '$summary' && mkdir -p '$clusters.extra_files_path' && cp *_cluster.fasta '$clusters.extra_files_path/' && cp *.png '$clusters.extra_files_path/' #if str($run_blast) == "yes" && mkdir -p '$blast_results.extra_files_path' && cp blast_results/* '$blast_results.extra_files_path/' #end if

param.name: rawReads
param.label: Raw PacBio Reads
param.help: Input FASTA file with raw PacBio reads.

outputs.collection: <discover_datasets pattern="(?P.*)\.fasta" format="fasta" directory="." /> <discover_datasets pattern="(?P.*)\.png" format="png" directory="." />

tool.help:
**What it does**
This tool runs the HmtG-PacBio Pipeline, a comprehensive workflow for processing Haemosporidian mitochondrial genome data from PacBio sequencing. It performs primer detection, sequence alignment, clustering, and optionally a local BLAST search.
**Inputs**
- **Raw PacBio Reads:** A FASTA file containing the raw reads from PacBio sequencing. - **Forward Primer:** The forward primer sequence. - **Reverse Primer:** The reverse primer sequence. - **Epsilon for DBSCAN:** The epsilon parameter for the DBSCAN clustering algorithm. - **Remove temporary files?:** Choose whether to keep or remove intermediate files. - **Run local BLASTn?:** Choose whether to run a local BLASTn search against the included database.
**Outputs**
- **Summary Distances:** A TSV file containing pairwise genetic distances. - **Haplotype Clusters and Plots:** A collection of FASTA files representing the final haplotype clusters, along with PNG plots from the analysis. - **BLASTn Results:** If enabled, a collection of text files with the BLASTn search results.
